name: sdd-gl
description: Spec-Driven Development with Gate/Loop protocol. Stack-agnostic process for features and fixes. Operates in Gate mode (human-controlled spec) and Loop mode (autonomous execution against inferred criteria). Supports Claude Code, Antigravity CLI, and Antigravity IDE.
author: Gerardo Maidana

skills.name: sdd-gate
skills.description: Gate protocol — human-controlled spec refinement and consistency validation

skills.name: sdd-loop
skills.description: Loop protocol — autonomous execution with persistence and crash recovery

skills.name: sdd-feature
skills.description: Start a new feature work item

skills.name: sdd-fix
skills.description: Start a bugfix work item with minimal Gate

skills.name: sdd-status
skills.description: Show dashboard of all Contracts grouped by Status

skills.name: sdd-metrics
skills.description: Displays engineering quality and DORA-style metrics: First-Pass Quality Rate (FPQR), average retries per contract, layer success rates, and ambiguity escalation rates

skills.name: sdd-audit
skills.description: Audits traceability between specification contracts and project codebase. Detects orphan specs (BR/AC without matching tests) and code without spec (domain logic without contracts)

skills.name: sdd-dashboard
skills.description: Generates and updates the standalone Living Visual Dashboard (docs/index.html) with real-time First-Pass Quality metrics, multi-layer verification matrix, timeline, and interactive contract explorer

skills.name: sdd-solve-agent
skills.description: Specialized repair agent for fast, localized fixes (lint errors, syntax issues, missing imports, minor type narrowing, off-by-one test assertions). Operates within the Loop with a 3-retry limit. Strictly prohibited from making architectural or business logic design decisions

skills.name: sdd-verifier-agent
skills.description: Specialized QA & Quality verification agent responsible for executing non-functional layers: static analysis, type checking, security scanning, and architectural boundary compliance against CONSTITUTION.md
